findings.mechanism: Pool size (5) is less than worker count (8) causing connection contention and worker saturation per reference on pool sizing against real concurrency ceiling.
findings.remediation: set pool_size>=8 or enable max_overflow to allow at least 3 extra connections

findings.mechanism: Pool size (5) limits concurrent DB connections, so active connections can reach 5 under full load, exceeding safe threshold per reference on pool sizing against real concurrency ceiling.
findings.remediation: set pool_size>=8 or enable max_overflow to allow at least 3 extra connections
